title: a result is shown once for each rising edge of EN, and a held EN makes no second request
note: COM-002, COM-004: the program counts the scans on which ERROR becomes TRUE. With EN held TRUE for three scans the handler answers once and the result is held, so the count rises by one for the edge and by nothing for the scans that follow (the handler of the native runtime is the absent one: STATUS 3). The held result is not a second request.
